meta.title: Nokka — Meeting recorder for Mac
meta.description: Nokka records meetings and, by default, transcribes them live with speaker labels right on your Mac. Connect your own Claude, OpenAI or ChatGPT account for minutes, and export to Markdown, Word, PDF, Hangul, Notion or Slack. macOS 14+, Apple silicon.
meta.ogAlt: Nokka's live transcript window with named speakers and notes

hero.headline:
Record the meeting.
Your Mac writes it down.
hero.subheadline: Nokka starts recording the moment you press the button, and by default transcribes and separates speakers on your Mac while people talk. Connect your own Claude, OpenAI or ChatGPT account only when you want minutes.
hero.screenshotAlt: Nokka's live transcript window. The speaker bar at the top has chips with pencil icons for 'Speaker 1' and a named participant; their lines run down the left, and the notes panel on the right holds a note taken at 00:01:05 that says the budget needs confirming. The interface is in Korean.
hero.caption: The live transcript window during a recording: click a speaker to name them, and take timestamped notes on the right. Sample conversation; the app's interface is in Korean.

how.heading: From recording to minutes, in one app
how.intro: Record when the meeting starts, transcribe while people talk, tidy up when it ends.

record.label: Record
record.title: Recording starts the moment you press it
record.description: Nokka doesn't wait for the transcription model to download or get ready. With default settings, the part recorded before the model was ready is transcribed from the original audio on your Mac after you stop.
points: When Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Slack huddles, Webex, Discord or Google Meet in a browser start using the mic or speakers, Nokka offers to record. For each app, choose ask, record automatically, or never.
Record audio only, or the screen too (full screen, a region or a window). Computer audio and microphone are switched on and off separately.
Check your sound before recording. While recording, Nokka watches for a dropped mic or silent computer audio, and carries on when the same earbuds reconnect.
Warnings show up where you're looking: the transcript window, the floating bar, the menu bar or a notification.
record.imageAlt: Nokka's main window while recording. Below the timer, a notice reads 'transcription model needed, about 845 MB' with an Install button; below that are computer audio and microphone switches and Pause, Stop and Open transcript buttons. The interface is in Korean.
record.imageCaption: The model isn't installed yet, and the recording is already running.
record.barAlt: The floating bar during a recording: timer and input levels, a red warning icon, and buttons including mic, pause, stop and bookmark.
record.barCaption: The floating bar shows a red icon when a warning needs your attention.

transcribe.label: Transcribe
transcribe.title: It writes down who said what, as they say it
transcribe.description: Live transcription runs on your Mac with Whisper, and speaker separation with Nemotron. Click a speaker in the bar at the top, or the speaker's name on a line, and a naming row opens right in the window. Type a name or pick a calendar attendee, your own name or a recent one; it carries through to the library, transcript files and minutes.
points: Notes typed in the panel next to the transcript are timestamped and included when minutes are written. ⌘⇧B bookmarks the current moment.
After the recording, you can name speakers while listening to a 5-second sample of each. Voices aren't stored.
Add attendee names, product names and in-house terms to the glossary; they're used as transcription hints and as a reference for minutes.
Choose Deepgram to transcribe in the cloud with your own API key. Only then does audio go to Deepgram.
transcribe.imageAlt: The live transcript window after clicking 'Speaker 1': a naming row has opened below the speaker bar, with a name field and two suggested names, above the speakers' lines. The interface is in Korean.
transcribe.imageCaption: Clicking 'Speaker 1' opens a naming row right below it. The name you choose goes on every line from that speaker.

minutes.label: Tidy up
minutes.title: It asks about the unclear parts, then writes the minutes
minutes.description: With an LLM connected, Nokka tidies the transcript and leaves questions about anything that needs a judgment call: names, terms, dates. Once you answer, it writes minutes and tags each item with the time of the line it's based on. The original transcript is never overwritten.
points: Connect Claude or OpenAI with your API key, or sign in with a ChatGPT subscription (experimental).
Click a citation chip to play from 5 seconds before that line. Keep several templates, and edit the minutes yourself.
Turn on automatic tidy-up and its questions appear in a small panel on the right of the screen, even while another app is in front.
Confirmed terms and meeting context stay on your Mac as Markdown memory, used for the next tidy-up and minutes.
'Ask your meetings' shows which memory items and meetings it would send, and sends nothing until you press Send.

dataPaths.heading: What leaves your Mac is spelled out in Settings
dataPaths.intro: Processing happens on your Mac by default. Cloud services are used only when you connect your own key or account, and the Data paths card in Settings › General shows what goes where with your current settings.

rows.connected: Claude, OpenAI or ChatGPT · transcript and related memory sent

localOnly.title: Local-only mode
localOnly.description: Blocks everything except model downloads. Deepgram switches to an engine on your Mac, and tidy-up, minutes, Ask your meetings, Notion and Slack are turned off.

facts: Deepgram, Claude and OpenAI keys and the ChatGPT sign-in are stored in the macOS Keychain.
No analytics or tracking SDKs in the app.
Deepgram's connection check only verifies the key and sends no audio.
Models for on-Mac transcription are downloaded from the internet on first use (about 845 MB).

files.heading: Everything ends up as ordinary files
files.intro: One recording, one folder. Transcript, subtitles, minutes and metadata sit side by side, ready for your knowledge base or automations.
files.treeLabel: What one recording folder under ~/Movies/Nokka/ contains

tree.name: transcript.json
tree.note: Times, speaker and text per segment

files.formatsNote: Pick what to include: minutes, transcript, timestamps, speaker names, bookmarks. Slack always gets the minutes only. Point Nokka at an Obsidian folder and it saves a note whenever minutes are created.

features.heading: Small things you'll use every day

menubar.title: Menu bar and shortcuts
menubar.description: Start and stop right from the menu bar. ⌘⇧R record, ⌘⇧P pause, ⌘⇧M mic, ⌘⇧B bookmark. Shortcuts can be changed and need Accessibility permission.

tracks.title: Separate audio tracks
tracks.description: Computer audio and microphone are saved as separate tracks, with RNNoise noise suppression on the mic. The unsuppressed original is kept as well and used for transcription.

meetingEnd.title: When the meeting ends
meetingEnd.description: Automatically recorded meetings stop after a 10-second countdown, and short automatic recordings ask before they're kept. You can also have recording stop after a long silence.

calendar.title: Calendar (optional)
calendar.description: Uses the current event's name as the recording title and its attendees as speaker-name suggestions, and reminds you 5 minutes before events with attendees.

notice.title: Copy a recording notice
notice.description: Other participants don't see a recording indicator on their screen. Copy your notice text and paste it into the meeting chat.

playback.title: Search and playback
playback.description: Search titles and transcripts in the library, and click a result or bookmark to play from there. The sentence you're hearing is highlighted, at 1×, 1.25× or 1.5× speed.

screen.title: Screen recording
screen.description: Full screen, a region or a window, with H.264 hardware encoding. Windows in other Spaces can be picked, and a webcam overlay is available.

safety.title: Recordings that survive a crash
safety.description: Files are written in 2-second fragments, so a recording stays playable up to the moment the app quit unexpectedly, and the next launch tells you how much was saved.

requirements.heading: Requirements and known limitations

items.detail: Apple silicon. Intel Macs are not supported.
Microphone. Screen & System Audio Recording only when you record computer audio or the screen. Setup asks only for what your chosen use needs; shortcuts, calendar and webcam ask when you use them.
The DMG is about 28 MB. On-Mac transcription downloads about 845 MB of models (Whisper + Nemotron) on first use; not needed if you only record or use Deepgram.
The app's interface and minutes are in Korean. The transcription language is chosen per recording: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, German or French.
The app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. The release notes list the file's SHA-256.
SwiftUI and ScreenCaptureKit. A native macOS app.

limits: Each recording is transcribed in one language. With Korean selected, Whisper and Deepgram drop English sentences, and the Apple engine transcribes them with broken spelling.
After-recording Whisper transcription can pull the first sentence's start time back into the silence before it.
Live speaker separation handles the mic and computer audio separately. The same person picked up by both isn't merged automatically.
If computer audio stops during a recording, for example after switching output devices, Nokka warns you but doesn't restart the capture. Stop and start the recording again.
On macOS 14 and 15, after-recording transcription with the Apple engine can cut off results for long files.
ChatGPT subscription sign-in is experimental and may stop working if OpenAI changes its policy. API-key connections are unaffected.

downloadCta.heading: Try it on your next meeting
downloadCta.subheading: Open the DMG and drag Nokka to Applications. On first launch, choose what to record and how to transcribe, and Nokka asks only for the permissions that needs.
